# Blackline 0.15.140

* **A link in a message gets a card** — the site, the page's title, the words under it and a small
  picture, the way Discord and Slack draw one. Discord makes them on a server: you send a link and
  their machine fetches the page for everyone in the conversation. There is no machine here, and a
  card each reader fetched would tell the site who opened your message, when, and from where. So
  your device fetches the page once, before the message goes, and the card travels inside it. The
  people you send it to never touch the link. Settings → Chat turns it off, and then nothing is
  fetched at all.
* Editing a link out of a message takes its card with it; editing one in gets a card.
* Everyone needs this version to talk to everyone else: a message can now carry a card, and an older
  build would not recognise the signature over it. The app updates itself.
